title: Very good

title: Excellent and original gift
text: It is a very enjoyable workshop that Vicky leads with great mastery. It is an excellent option as an original gift or as a way to relax and engage in entertaining concentration. A super positive experience that will not disappoint you
author: M2627EPrafaels

title: Unique experience and you take home your own handmade tile
text: I always look for something unique to do in a city that reflects that city. Seeing all of the mosaic work around Seville and then getting an opportunity to make a small tile is a great way to appreciate the effort you see all around. Great way to escape the heat for a couple of hours and walk away with your own special handmade creation!
author: KVandT

title: Amazing Workshop!
text:
I took a mosaic workshop with my two sisters and it was one of the best experiences we’ve had in a long time. We are not super creative but we came out, each with a piece we’re genuinely proud of!
Viki is an exceptional teacher. What really set her apart was how knowledgeable she is! She wove in the history of mosaic art throughout, making the whole experience so much richer. You don’t just learn how to make something; you come away understanding where this ancient craft comes from and why it matters.

title: Mosaic fun!
